ex.en: The sun rises in the east.
ex.ko: 해는 동쪽에서 뜬다.

easy: The eastern part of a place.

ex.en: It snows a lot in the east of our state.
ex.ko: 우리 주의 동부에는 눈이 많이 온다.

easy: Having a lot of heat.

ex.en: Do not touch the hot stove!
ex.ko: 뜨거운 가스레인지를 만지지 마!

easy: For more time.

ex.en: Can we play a little longer?
ex.ko: 조금 더 오래 놀아도 돼요?

easy: Having to do with doctors and health care.

ex.en: The nurse opened a medical kit to help my scraped knee.
ex.ko: 간호사는 내 까진 무릎을 치료하려고 의료 상자를 열었다.

easy: A large area of nature that is kept safe for everyone.

ex.en: We saw deer in the national park.
ex.ko: 우리는 국립공원에서 사슴을 봤다.

easy: An open grassy place in a city where people can play.

ex.en: We played tag in the park after school.
ex.ko: 우리는 방과 후에 공원에서 술래잡기를 했다.

easy: A place where baseball games are played.

ex.en: My dad took me to the park to watch a baseball game.
ex.ko: 아빠가 나를 야구 경기를 보러 야구장에 데려가셨다.

easy: A show, such as a play or a concert.

ex.en: We clapped after the piano performance.
ex.ko: 우리는 피아노 공연이 끝나고 박수를 쳤다.

easy: The act of putting on a show.

ex.en: She was nervous before her dance performance.
ex.ko: 그녀는 춤 공연 전에 긴장했다.

easy: To push down on something.

ex.en: Press the button to ring the bell.
ex.ko: 버튼을 눌러서 벨을 울려 봐.

easy: To push someone to do something.

ex.en: Mom pressed me to eat more broccoli.
ex.ko: 엄마는 브로콜리를 더 먹으라고 나를 재촉하셨다.

easy: The part an actor plays in a story.

ex.en: I got the role of a tree in the school play.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 연극에서 나무 역할을 맡았다.

easy: Tested and found to work well.

ex.en: This is a tried and tested way to bake bread.
ex.ko: 이것은 빵을 굽는 검증된 방법이다.
